subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as the core public config surface for tiered bootstrap context selection in this PR?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and source-backed, but choosing a new config/default surface affects prompt context, session state, upgrade expectations, and overlapping bootstrap-control proposals in a way automation should not decide.

options.title: Sponsor this PR shape
options.body: Proceed with this additive config path after the docs finding is fixed and no-override defaults, hook extras, schema/help, and tests are refreshed against current main.

options.title: Fold into broader bootstrap selection
options.body: Pause this PR behind the broader deterministic bootstrap/context proposal and design one selector contract for tiering, session filtering, and prompt-pressure work.

options.title: Decline the new config knob
options.body: Keep existing fixed filters and steer users toward current `contextInjection`, lightweight context, bootstrap budgets, and doctor guidance instead.

recommendation.title: Sponsor this PR shape
recommendation.body: Proceed with this additive config path after the docs finding is fixed and no-override defaults, hook extras, schema/help, and tests are refreshed against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior maintainer-side review context and adjacent bootstrap/config documentation history make this the best available decision owner.
